address: 1F The Westin Chosun Hotel, 106 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, 04533, South Korea
bio: Instantly memorable with its crimson décor, this high-end restaurant at The Westin Chosun Seoul, specializes in Cantonese cuisine. The elegant space offers a taste of the best in Chinese-style formal dining, with its classic yet innovative dishes. Hong Yuan’s commitment to using the freshest ingredients to make healthy and tasty food is unparalleled, as seen in its heavy use of seafood, tofu and vegetables. Live music during dinner service....
